resources.string: No voices yet. Nothing of Apple\'s comes with Classic Voices: import firmware below, and its voices are taken out of it.
%1$d voices ready. Classic Voices is your text-to-speech engine.
%1$d voices ready. To hear them in TalkBack and other apps, choose Classic Voices as the preferred engine in text-to-speech settings.

Each firmware is streamed from Apple\'s own servers. Only its root filesystem is downloaded, the speech engine and voices are copied out, and the rest is deleted. Use Wi-Fi: the sizes are what will be downloaded.

Enhanced iOS 5 and 6 voices, and the Mac OS X Lion, Mountain Lion and Mavericks voices, downloaded from Apple once the engine they need is imported.
Apple\'s pronunciation rules: iOS is spelled out, OS X is OS ten, and so on
Compact voice for pitch changes, as VoiceOver did: enhanced and premium voices can\'t change pitch themselves

None for this phone (%1$s). The voices run on an exact emulation of the iPhone\'s processor, which may be slower than real time on some phones. Fast engine code, built from your own firmware, makes them several times faster: import it from a data pack.
Fred, Victoria, Alex and the other MacinTalk voices come from Panthera Speech, a separate app: github.com/tgeczy/panthera-speech
